Name: (AT) Sparks Albums
Author: VinillaBean
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][b][size=4]Content[/size][/b]
[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]I have been deeply obsessed with the band Sparks lately and needed to express that obsession somehow, so here we are. This mod adds custom pixel art of 29 of Sparks' main albums as Alternative Textures furniture, plus a bonus Halfnelson version of the first album.

Can be used on any vanilla painting that is 32x32 in size.

[size=4][b]Installation and Removal[/b][/size]
[/font][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] if you haven't already, this mod won't work without it!
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip and put the file where you put the rest of your Stardew Valley mods in your Mods folder.
4. Launch game![b] To access the albums, you must purchase a paint bucket from Robin's shop and use it on a painting.[/b]
(5. If you would no longer like to use this mod, simply delete it from the mod folder)

Check out my [url=https://ko-fi.com/vinilla]ko-fi[/url] or [url=https://vinillavin.neocities.org/]neocities[/url] if you enjoyed my mod! Thanks for checking it out :D (also check out Sparks' music if you haven't before, it's amazing! Kimono My House is a great place to get started.)[/font]
